landingPage.heroDescription: A one-page site for local trades that shows your services and hours, checks coverage by street or postcode, and keeps a call button within reach.
landingPage.about: Callout is a one-page website for an independent plumber, electrician or other local tradesperson. It is built to win trust quickly and turn nearby visitors into phone calls. Visitors see your services and working hours, check whether you cover their street or postcode, and call you from buttons that stay easy to reach on a phone. Emergency availability is highlighted, so urgent jobs find you first. The copy, services, hours, coverage areas and contact details live in one content file, so making the site yours means editing text, not code. It is a React and TypeScript project that deploys from GitHub to Hostinger Node.js hosting in a few clicks.

features.title: Coverage checker
features.description: Visitors type a street or postcode to see whether you cover their area before they call.

features.title: Click-to-call everywhere
features.description: Call buttons sit in the header, the hero and every section, sized for phones.

features.title: Emergency availability
features.description: Your emergency hours stand out, so visitors with urgent jobs know when to call.

features.title: Services and work gallery
features.description: Show the jobs you take on and photos of past work in clear, easy-to-scan sections.

features.title: Edit in one place
features.description: Services, hours, coverage areas and contact details live in one content file.

features.title: Ready for any screen
features.description: Layouts are tuned for phones, tablets and desktops, with accessible navigation and forms.
